biomarkers.name: BCR-ABL1 fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Most cases harbor e1a2/p190; a minority harbor b2a2 or b3a2/p210. Both are targetable with ABL-class TKIs. TKI-based therapy is standard; ponatinib- and dasatinib-based regimens are established options in adults. Chemo-free regimens (for example, dasatinib + blinatumomab) are increasingly used. MRD can be monitored by RQ-PCR for BCR-ABL1 transcript, ideally supplemented by Ig/TCR-based MRD assays because BCR-ABL1 transcript quantitation alone may be insufficient in some cases.

biomarkers.name: IKZF1 mutations / deletions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse; contributes to the 'IKZF1-plus' subgroup when accompanied by specific additional copy-number lesions

biomarkers.name: T315I
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confers resistance to imatinib, dasatinib, nilotinib, and bosutinib; ponatinib retains activity

biomarkers.name: MRD (BCR-ABL1 RQ-PCR + IgH-TCR)
biomarkers.clinical_use: MRD kinetics guide risk stratification and transplant decisions

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: B-ALL morphology as per B_ALL with defining BCR-ABL1 fusion
variants: p190 minor breakpoint (predominant isoform in Ph+ B-ALL, especially in adults)
p210 major breakpoint (minority of Ph+ B-ALL; may overlap biologically with CML lymphoid blast crisis)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; molecular monitoring drives management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Chemo-free / immunotherapy-first regimens (dasatinib + blinatumomab) are transforming Ph+ B-ALL management

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: B-cell precursor with defining BCR-ABL1 fusion driving constitutive kinase activity
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: B-cell precursor differentiation as per B-ALL; BCR-ABL1 fusion drives proliferation without altering precursor B-lineage assignment
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: p190 (minor breakpoint, predominant in de novo Ph+ ALL) vs p210 (major breakpoint, overlaps with CML lymphoid blast crisis) fusion isoforms are both seen; TKI resistance mutations (for example T315I) drive kinase inhibitor resistance rather than a specific lineage switch
